guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Sign Up for UPTIME with Your Email
guide.description: Go to the UPTIME campaign page and enter the email address you want tied to your points. Balances are held on the waitlist server, so the same address works from any device.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Confirm the 6-Digit Code
guide.description: Check your inbox for the code and enter it. The same code signs you in later, so there is no password to store.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Reserve Your Queue Position
guide.description: Open the statement view to see your balance and queue position. A countdown runs to the opening date, when partners are announced and first-access positions open.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Referral Link
guide.description: Copy your link from the Referrals panel. Campaign materials put a referral at 750 points once that person joins and links X, and your own X connection at 250 points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Machine Uptime
guide.description: The dashboard shows a machine uptime heatmap plus a schedule of contributions listing each route, its point value and its status. Check which routes are still open, since they change as partners are announced.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your X Account When Linking Opens
guide.description: X connection is not available yet. The dashboard says it opens before Epoch 1 closes and that nothing is lost by waiting, so check back rather than hunting for a workaround.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check the Leaderboard
guide.description: The leaderboard shows your rank, your share of the leader’s total, and a breakdown of how you got there. Use it to find routes you have not completed.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
